claims.claim: Camtek received more than $105M of multi-system orders in June from a tier-1 OSAT and a leading HBM manufacturer for AI applications, with delivery scheduled in 2027; earlier Q1 OSAT orders exceeded $90M.

risks.risk: AI advanced-packaging demand is concentrated among a limited set of large OSAT/HBM/IDM customers and may be cyclical.

unknowns.unknown: Customer identities and exact system-level margins are undisclosed.

claims.claim: Camtek posted record Q2 revenue of $133.2M, guided Q3 to $158M-$160M, reported more than $600M of 2026 YTD orders, and expects H2 revenue growth above 30% versus H1 with further growth into 2027.

risks.risk: GAAP operating margin fell to 20.4% from 25.9% year over year and GAAP net income declined 31%, despite revenue growth.

contradictions.contradiction: Strong order/revenue acceleration coexists with weaker GAAP profitability year over year; margin quality must be reconciled before high execution confidence.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of >30% H2 growth beyond the current AI packaging capex cycle remains unproven.
